## Paired deltas against beat-only

Positive deltas mean the condition scores higher than beat-only on the same songs. `wins` counts songs where the condition beat the baseline. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests need at least five pairs; with four songs the p-value is reported as `n/a` and the comparison stays descriptive.

## Notes

- Songs are short (19-116 s) and only four conditions' songs are available, so the paired statistics are descriptive rather than confirmatory.
- BAS uses the kinematic beat detector in `src/beat_alignment.py` (sigma = 0.15 s), not a human annotation.
- The multi-level condition is expected to raise expressiveness (energy and beat-response correlation) more than synchronisation, because both conditions place clips on the beat grid.
